page.overview:
Who is Jonas Revera?

Jonas Revera is a character in Cars that appeared in Sally Carrera's flashback scene to Radiator Springs' heyday.

Jonas is one of the travelers seen visiting the town in the 1960s.

Jonas Revera is a 1944 Hollismobile Driftwood with a light blue livery with with a beige roof. He has brown eyes. His registration plate number is 2769.
